description: Public stock-iPhone vs Chromagraph photo pairs used by fit_look.py. File names are relative to --data-dir. Add a pair by appending an entry; no code changes are needed.

fields.use: 'fit' = candidate for fitting, kept only if registration passes the checks in fit_look.py (otherwise preview only); 'preview' = preview only, never fitted
fields.round: 1 = pairs used for the v1 LUT (v1 is regenerated from these for comparison); later rounds add data
fields.weight: relative weight in both fitting stages (default 1)
fields.toe_weight: weight of this pair's shadow samples (stock luma below mid-grey) when fitting the tone curve (default 1)
fields.neutral_weight: weight of this pair in the neutral-axis evidence (default = weight); 0 for night white balance
fields.same_exposure: true when both images come from the same RAW exposure; the first such fitted pair anchors the reported gains, and these pairs get their own held-out table
fields.deliberate_exposure: free text shown in the report when a pair was deliberately shot at a different exposure
fields.mask_top_fraction: share of the frame height masked at the top of both images (labels)
fields.probes: named regions measured in the report; 'boxes' are [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the stock frame (Chromagraph values come from the registered image), 'chroma_boxes' are fractions of the Chromagraph frame and are used instead when given
